Our Purpose
At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity.

It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future.

And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.
By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.
Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching
Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.
Deloitte Insights is Deloitte’s global publishing imprint for business research and insights. We publish 400+ articles, reports, and multimedia projects annually with the goal of educating, informing, and inspiring Deloitte clients and prospective clients on the business issues that matter most to their strategic agendas.

From leadership and workforce evolution, to AI and emerging technologies, to energy resilience and decarbonization, and beyond, Deloitte Insights (DI) publishes data-driven thought leadership for global C-suite and board-level executives across industries.
What will your typical day look like?
As a global senior editor and content strategist covering sustainability, energy resilience, and decarbonization for Deloitte Insights, you’ll work with subject matter specialists, researchers, data science and visualization professionals, designers, video strategists, and production specialists to develop research and insights projects ranging from reports and articles to infographics and videos.
Leverage sustainability subject matter expertise, business acumen, and editorial skills to collaborate with Deloitte business leaders, internal and external thought leaders, researchers, and marketing teams to develop and execute research and insights projects for the Deloitte global member firm network.
Act as a journalist covering a global sustainability beat, building and nurturing a network of Deloitte professionals, identifying opportunities to amplify thought leadership, and serving as a trusted advisor on content planning and insights development.
Ensure the intellectual rigor, credibility, and accuracy of published insights by critically evaluating data sources, methodology, claims, statistics, assumptions, and conclusions in collaboration with researchers and subject matter experts.
Assess insights projects for novelty in the generative AI era, alignment with audience information needs, and relevance to Deloitte’s sustainability expertise and business priorities to deliver differentiated client value.
Serve as a storytelling strategist, recommending the most effective content formats and leveraging multimedia and multimodal storytelling across reports, articles, infographics, videos, dashboards, and other digital experiences.
Adapt to project requirements by serving as a ghostwriter, editor, infographic copywriter, or scriptwriter, applying the appropriate level of editorial support from developmental editing to final copy polishing.
Guide authors in communicating their insights effectively while preserving their voice, advising on novelty, clarity, accuracy, utility, audience engagement, and adherence to editorial best practices.
Advocate for business audiences by applying a deep understanding of content consumption behaviors to shape content strategy and delivery.
Manage projects throughout the content development lifecycle, coordinating with authors, designers, marketers, and cross-functional teams to ensure objectives, quality standards, expectations, and timelines are achieved.
Edit content for factual accuracy, readability, grammar, punctuation, flow, style, and compliance with SEO and GEO best practices.
Utilize generative AI in accordance with firm policies and standards to enhance efficiency while maintaining human-led design, development, oversight, and quality assurance.
Coach Deloitte content creators on language usage, writing style, storytelling techniques, editorial standards, and Deloitte Insights production processes.
Lead and contribute to initiatives focused on storytelling innovation, quality control, editorial excellence, and continuous process improvement.
Mentor junior editors, review their work, and promote consistency, quality, and best practices across sustainability-focused content and insights.

Global Growth creates an opportunity for you to build a new perspective and see both Deloitte and our priority clients through a global lens. While collaborating with some of our most experienced leaders and talent across the organization, your voice will influence Deloitte’s strategic direction, growth, brand, and impact in the market.

Your network will rapidly expand, and you will create meaningful connections and relationships globally. You will build deep institutional knowledge and gain an understanding of clients’ heart-of-business issues, and Deloitte’s offerings and solutions.

Global Growth’s diverse, inclusive, and flexible culture is an opportunity for you to become a role model for agile working.

Minimum 8 years of experience in writing, editing, and copyediting content in American English (business journalism experience preferred)
Bachelor’s degree (preferably in English, literature, journalism, communications, or similar)
Deep experience in and familiarity with editing energy, sustainability, and decarbonization articles and research reports
Exceptional editing and copyediting skills, and mastery of US English grammar, conversational phrasing, and Associated Press style, and the ability to clearly and influentially explain edits to authors
Exceptional writing and oral communication skills; proven ability to translate complex concepts into easily digestible terms
Excellent attention to detail, laser focus on quality, and demonstrated ability to clarify a story’s main message
Journalist's instinct for fact-checking and critical thinking; ability to read research with healthy skepticism, ask probing questions about data and methodology, spot logical gaps or overstatements, and ensure precision in language around statistics and research findings
Outside-in orientation, considering all content projects from the perspective of the target audience and their needs/interests

Position Summary: Marketplace is looking for a correspondent. The ideal candidate has proven audio and video reporting abilities, and a passion for covering business and financial news in Marketplace’s explanatory and accessible style.

Marketplace is focused on engaging communities directly to create content that always informs, includes, and inspires. We achieve this by building trust and connection through journalism that is audience-centered, distinctive, useful, and emotionally resonant.

This means: Developing a truly audience-first approach to reporting and production Producing work that succeeds across platforms and formats Increasing our video and visual storytelling capabilities Collaborating more effectively across shows, platforms, and teams Prioritizing journalism that is immersive, memorable, and worth people’s time A correspondent will cover daily stories and features on subjects from corporate news to consumer behavior, housing to the changing workforce, macroeconomic trends to financial markets.

This position sits in the collective bargaining agreement between MPR and Screen Actors Guild—American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (“SAG-AFTRA”). Expected Compensation Range: $106,371 - $127,645 per year.

The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity. Location: Remote Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled. Position Responsibility: Pitch and report ideas for daily news items, features and digital elements for Marketplace shows and digital platforms. Cover a variety of assignments including occasional hosting duties. Write sharp, concise, and accurate copy, for audio and video segments.

Synthesize multiple strands of a story and produce under tight deadlines. Deliver substantive reports quickly on varied subjects as shows need. Consistently deliver stories with Marketplace’s writing style and pace. Gather information, audio and video for reports and programs. Assist other reporters, producers, and editors with information.

Maintain a wide variety of sources. Other duties as assigned, including meetings and other events. Required Experience and Education: BA degree or equivalent work experience. Correspondent Level : 15+ years reporting or similar experience, national level experience preferred.

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities: Correspondent Level: Breadth of general industry knowledge. Strong oral and written skills with ability to deliver originality in writing. Capacity to deliver quick turn-around reporting. Experience producing audio, video and digital stories.

Ability to develop stories with multiple interviews, scene changes and strong knowledge of subject matter. Ability to deliver top-quality stories. Ability to set fresh directions in stories. Knowledge of various process approaches and necessary resources for a given project/assignment. Demonstrated reporting and production skills.

Ability to maintain high journalistic standards under deadline pressure, including standards of balance and fairness. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Skill in creative use of sound, writing and storytelling. Ability to develop mastery of all recording and production equipment and techniques.

National reporting experience Preferred Skills and Experience: Radio reporting experience Knowledge of specific industries Digital production knowledge Reporting to This Position: None Physical Demands and Working Conditions: Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Ability to manage some work outside of standard office hours as needed. Physical Demands: Required to move about in an office environment and sit for extended periods of time. Required to move about in the community. Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping.

Job Overview: The Senior Managing Editor, Content and Test Development provides strategic and operational leadership for assessment content and production editorial teams.

Accountable for editorial quality across the full assessment lifecycle—from item development through final production, including ancillary materials—while advancing AI-enabled editorial workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability. Job Responsibilities: Editorial Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of assessment content and production editors, including workload planning, cross-training, and performance coaching.
Establish clear workflows and handoffs between content, production, and editorial teams; provide escalation support on complex style and content issues.
Assessment Content Editing
Oversee editorial review of test items, passages, graphics, item development plans, performance-level descriptors, manuals, and technical documentation.
Enforce Chicago, APA, and AP style alongside state-specific style guides.
Production Editing & QA
Direct production editing for paper-based and digital materials: test books, ancillary materials, reports, and operational documentation.
Oversee proofreading, version control, and final quality checks prior to release or submission.
AI-Enabled Editorial Innovation
Lead responsible adoption of AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Grammarly Business, Writer) for copyediting, style compliance, and QA while preserving human editorial judgment.
Assist in the development of internal guidelines for ethical, secure AI use, train editors on consistent tool usage.
Implement workflow automation (e.g., Power Automate, SharePoint) and AI-powered document comparison for version control and error detection.
Operations & Collaboration
Design scalable workflows supporting high-volume, concurrent deadlines; track quality and turnaround metrics to drive continuous improvement.
Contribute editorial expertise to proposals, staffing models, and resourcing plans. Serve as a trusted editorial advisor to leadership, project teams, and clients.

Master's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, or related field.
15+ years of professional editing experience, including educational assessment, test development, or complex technical publishing.
Demonstrated people management experience in deadline-driven environments.
Exceptional command of Chicago, APA, and AP style; experience editing assessment items, technical reports, and high-stakes testing content.
